title: Charity Membership Sales Representative
salary_text: £20000 - £50000 per year (£20+ Per Hour OTE ? Uncapped Commis)
description:
Charity Membership Sales Representative £20+ Per Hour OTE Uncapped Commission

Realistic earnings: £20+ per hour, including commission
Top performers: £30 £40 per hour
Hours: Part-time Friday to Sunday (3 days per week, consideration give to more days)
Location: Norfolk Norwich, King's Lynn, Great Yarmouth, Dereham, Fakenham and surrounding areas

Earn great money. Meet great people. Make a difference.

Are you confident, outgoing and enjoy talking to people?

Would you like to earn £20+ per hour while helping protect Norfolk's wildlife?

CF Fundraising Ltd is recruiting enthusiastic Charity Membership Fundraisers to represent Norfolk Wildlife Trust at busy shopping centres, garden centres, country shows and events across Norfolk.

Our fundraisers realistically earn £20+ per hour, including commission, with some of our top performers achieving £30 £40 per hour.

You'll receive a guaranteed hourly wage, with additional uncapped commission the more successful you are, the more you can earn.

No previous fundraising experience is necessary. If you're a natural communicator, enjoy meeting new people and are motivated by achieving results, we'll provide all the training and support you need.

What's involved?

You'll be the face of Norfolk Wildlife Trust, engaging with members of the public, sharing the Trust's conservation work and encouraging people to become regular members.

Working at pre-booked venues and events, you'll:
- Approach members of the public and start friendly conversations.
- Explain how membership helps protect Norfolk's wildlife and natural habitats.
- Inspire people to become supporters of the Trust.
- Work towards individual and team membership targets.
- Deliver a positive, professional experience.

Every membership you secure helps support wildlife conservation across Norfolk.

What we're looking for

We're interested in people with the confidence and personality to engage with the public.

Previous experience in sales, fundraising, retail, hospitality, customer service, recruitment or promotions would be useful, but is not essential.

You'll need to be:
- Friendly, confident and approachable.
- Positive, motivated and comfortable working towards targets.
- A good communicator who enjoys meeting new people.
- Reliable, professional and well presented.
- Available to work Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
- A full UK driving licence holder with access to your own vehicle.

What we offer
- Realistic earnings of £20+ per hour including commission.
- Uncapped commission, with top performers earning £30 £40 per hour.
- Guaranteed hourly pay with a National Living Wage guarantee.
- Comprehensive training and ongoing support.
- Six weeks' annual leave pro rata, including bank holidays.
- Contribution towards travel expenses.
- Accommodation provided when overnight stays are required.
- Uniform, tablet and all equipment supplied.
- A friendly, supportive and rewarding working environment.

Why Norfolk Wildlife Trust?

Norfolk Wildlife Trust is the county's largest environmental charity and the oldest Wildlife Trust in the UK.

Managing more than 60 nature reserves across Norfolk, the Trust works tirelessly to protect wildlife, restore habitats and create a wilder future for generations to come.

This is more than a sales job. Every membership you secure helps protect the wildlife and wild places that make Norfolk special.

Interested?

If you enjoy meeting people, are motivated by earning potential and want to do something genuinely worthwhile, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today!

Send your CV to Jo Hill

CF Fundraising Ltd is an equal opportunities employer working on behalf of Norfolk Wildlife Trust. All applications will be processed in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant - Norwich, Norfolk - Salary Competitive

My client is a well-established, privately owned leisure and hospitality business expanding their dedicated group holidays division, seeking a Sales Consultant with travel or tourism experience to join a team genuinely passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team within a respected, four-decade heritage business where your travel industry expertise as a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant will directly shape customer journeys and build lasting client relationships.

As a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant, you'll have the opportunity to proactively identify and approach new client prospects whilst nurturing and growing existing relationships through understanding their unique requirements and designing tailored group travel packages. You'll manage incoming enquiries from initial contact through to confirmation and booking, research and negotiate accommodation and services with hotels and suppliers, and develop detailed, personalised itineraries that bring group travel experiences to life. Working towards agreed sales targets, you'll create engaging promotional materials, handle payment processing, undertake occasional travel for client visits and supplier meetings, and contribute to the continued growth of the group holidays division giving you genuine variety, real customer impact, and the satisfaction of crafting memorable travel experiences as a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant.

This Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant role would suit someone with a background in travel, tourism, or hospitality who brings confident, persuasive communication with strong negotiation ability. You'll be highly organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, and possess a genuine passion for travel and delivering outstanding customer experiences. Your self-starter mindset, travel industry knowledge, and enthusiasm for understanding client needs will help you thrive in this customer-focused role.

What you'll enjoy as part of the package:
- Competitive salary
- Full-time position (part-time considered for the right candidate)
- Opportunity to join a growing team with a great customer attitude
- Varied, customer-facing role with genuine impact

My client is a well-established, privately owned leisure and hospitality business with over four decades of heritage and a strong reputation as one of Britain's foremost operators in the holiday market. Headquartered in a prestigious listed building in Norwich with offices in Yorkshire and Scotland, they offer a diverse portfolio spanning UK domestic breaks, escorted overseas holidays, rail journeys, ocean cruises, and European river cruises. Their loyal customer base shares genuine enthusiasm for travel, and their team shares a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences making this an ideal environment for a Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant with travel industry experience who values both customer satisfaction and genuine team culture.

If this Groups & Specialist Holidays Sales Consultant opportunity sounds like the right next step for you, get in touch with Select Recruitment today to find out more.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Sales Co-Ordinator

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent (office-based)

Location: West Norfolk (on-site)

Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday (Apply online only)

About the Company

We are recruiting on behalf of a successful manufacturing and engineering organisation with an established reputation for delivering high-quality products and services to a diverse customer base. Due to continued growth an exciting opportunity has arisen to join their commercial support team.

We welcome applications from individuals with transferable experience gained within manufacturing, engineering, technical sales support, customer service or commercial administration environments.

The Sales Office Co-ordinator will help keep the day-to-day sales office running smoothly. It is a varied role covering customer enquiries, quotations, order processing, sales administration, reporting and general support for the Sales team.

The role will also involve working with other departments to ensure enquiries and orders continue to progress efficiently whilst customers are kept informed throughout the process.

- Process and manage sales orders accurately and promptly through company workflow systems.
- Respond to customer enquiries via telephone and email, providing updates, quotations and product information.
- Support the Sales team by ensuring they have the information, materials and administrative support required.
- Prepare sales reports for company directors using sales data and statistics.
- Work closely with Accounts, Engineering and Production teams to ensure enquiries and orders continue to progress smoothly.
- Provide after-sales support, resolve customer queries and maintain strong customer relationships.

Skills & Experience
- Strong communication skills, with the confidence to communicate clearly with customers and colleagues both verbally and in writing.
- Ability to organise and prioritise workload effectively whilst working in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling orders, quotations and documentation.
- A customer-focused approach with the ability to build positive working relationships.
- Good analytical skills, with the ability to review data and prepare reports.
- Competent user of Microsoft 365 applications. Training will be provided on company systems.
- Previous experience in sales administration, customer service or office co-ordination roles.

We're looking for a highly organised and customer-focused individual who enjoys building relationships and keeping processes moving.

You will ideally have:
- Experience within sales administration, customer service, commercial support or office co-ordination roles.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy when handling orders, quotations and documentation.

title: Senior Customer Sales Executive
description:
Senior Customer Sales Executive

Location: Norwich

Hours: Full time, permanent 37.5 hours per week

Working pattern: Hybrid minimum 3 days per week in the office

Salary: £28,000 £30,000 per annum, dependent on experience, plus performance-related earnings of up to £12,000 per year.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Customer Sales Executive who combines a natural ability to build relationships with a genuine passion for delivering excellent customer service.

This is a sales focused role with clear targets and the opportunity to earn additional performance related pay.

You'll take a solution based approach to every conversation, listening carefully to customers, understanding their individual circumstances and recommending the products or services that best meet their needs.

You'll be commercially minded and motivated to achieve results, while ensuring the customer remains at the heart of everything you do.

About You

You're a natural people person who builds trust, listens well and genuinely cares about finding the right outcome for the customer.

We're looking for someone who:
- Has previous customer service experience (essential).
- Has experience in solution-based or service-led sales (advantageous).
- Is commercially aware and comfortable working towards targets.
- Takes a customer-first approach to sales.
- Is confident communicating with a wide range of people.
- Is self-motivated, organised and able to manage their workload.
- Is confident using technology and CRM systems.

You'll understand that how you achieve your results matters just as much as the results themselves. A sales-at-any-cost approach isn't what we're looking for.

Salary and Benefits
- Basic salary of £28,000 £30,000, dependent on experience.
- Opportunity to earn up to an additional £12,000 per year through performance-related pay.
- 233 hours of annual leave, increasing with length of service. This includes bank holidays, which you may be required to work as part of your rota.
- Discounts on groceries, shopping, holidays, insurance, days out, restaurants and more.
- 24/7 employee assistance programme.
- Family and friends' discounts on products and services.
- Free on-site parking.

Working Pattern

You'll work 37.5 hours per week across five days out of seven, Monday to Sunday. Shifts will be eight hours, including a 30-minute unpaid break, scheduled between 08:00 and 20:00.

This is a hybrid role based in Norwich, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. Further flexibility may be available depending on performance.

Weekend and bank holiday working will form part of the rota. Please note that any hybrid or remote working must be undertaken within the UK.

Additional Information

This role is subject to pre-employment screening, including a basic DBS check and two years of referencing. All screening must be completed before your start date. This may mean your start date needs to be adjusted if checks are not completed in time.

If you re interested in applying or require more information, please contact Megan Reeve at Atkinson Moss. If you have an up-to-date CV please include it with your email.

Not the job for you? Please do reach out as we have multiple Office Support Jobs available in Norfolk and Suffolk.
